Market today: Mixed signals. Tech saw a selloff, but Nvidia is up premarket, and strategists see a "fat pitch" for a rebound. The "AI downturn" is still a concern for your concentrated book.

Your holdings: Most are in deep red, especially leveraged ETFs like SOXL (-86%), MUU (-74%), and PLTU (-46%). These are high-risk on margin. CRWD is a bright spot, up 31%.

Watch: How premarket tech strength translates to market open. Also, keep an eye on any further news regarding the "AI downturn."

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, deeply underwater positions.
plays: Consider trimming CRWD to lock in gains, especially with the overall market uncertainty and your margin exposure.
Review stops on highly leveraged positions like SOXL (-86%) and MUU (-74%) to prevent further deep losses.
NVDD (Direxion Daily NVDA Bull 2X) shows a long setup (entry 47.17-47.08, stop 46.84) and aligns with Nvidia's premarket rise.
